lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dōu duànliàn shēntǐ ma?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 差不多，早上我都去跑步。
lines.pinyin: Chàbuduō, zǎoshang wǒ dōu qù pǎobù.
lines.en: Mostly, I go running in the morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Running is very good for your health.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Duì, nǐ yě xǐhuan yùndòng ma?
lines.en: Right, do you like sports too?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xǐhuan, dànshì wǒ tài máng le.
lines.en: I do, but I'm too busy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Even when busy, look after your health.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 你说得对。我可以游泳吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Wǒ kěyǐ yóuyǒng ma?
lines.en: You're right. Can I go swimming?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 当然，游泳也是很好的运动。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán, yóuyǒng yě shì hěn hǎo de yùndòng.
lines.en: Of course, swimming is a great sport too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 那周末我们一起去游泳吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà zhōumò wǒmen yìqǐ qù yóuyǒng ba.
lines.en: Then let's go swimming together this weekend.
